decisions.statement: What a call said is handed in, read by the one reader every command reads by.
Text is said at its flag or read from a file.
Text said both ways is refused.
A file named `-` is the input.
One call reads the input once.
Two flags naming one input are refused.
Text read whole keeps its line endings and text read as a line loses those line endings.
A subject read from a file has no line ending.
A path that is not absolute is read against the repository root.

definition: what an email command reads off its arguments
